entries.mechanism: Quantity-definition difference over the same authoritative document (Alaska DPA APA Need and Maximum Payment Standards, 1/1/2026). Axiom's concept is the total APA payment standard for code A1E ($1,356: federal SSI plus state supplement); PolicyEngine's gov/states/ak/dpa/ssp/payment_standard stores only the monthly state supplementation portion ($362). The residual equals the 2026 SSI A Individual payment standard ($994) from the same document. Axiom's own derived a_individual_monthly_state_supplement (1356 - 994 = 362) equals PolicyEngine's value exactly, so both engines agree on the supplement.

Axiom's derived a_couple_one_eligible_monthly_state_supplement (1515 - 994 = 521) equals PolicyEngine's value exactly.

Same-document quantity-definition difference. Axiom's concept is the total APA payment standard for code B1E ($1,031); PolicyEngine's ak/dpa/ssp/payment_standard stores the state supplement only ($368, the whole-dollar amount published in SSA's state assistance table). The residual ($663) is the 2026 SSI B Individual standard $662.67 from the same document plus the $0.33 whole-dollar rounding of the supplement (1031 - 662.67 = 368.33, published/stored as 368). Axiom's derived b_individual_monthly_state_supplement equals 368.33 versus PolicyEngine's 368.
